newsitem.title: UK: Lehman buys Acorn shares from Olivetti.
newsitem.headline: Lehman buys Acorn shares from Olivetti.

text.p: Lehman Brothers International said on Tuesday it bought 13.25 million shares in Britain's Acorn Group Plc from Italy's Olivetti Telemedia, representing a 14.7 percent stake in Acorn.
Lehman said it planned to sell the shares in the computer group to investors.
Lehman said the deal, which took place on Monday, would broaden Acorn's investor base and mark another step in the Olivetti group's planned asset disposal programme.
Acorn's shares were marked down 9.5p at 178 at 0840 GMT.
Earlier this year, Lehman completed the sale of a 14.7 percent stake in Acorn that it bought from Olivetti in June 1996.
Lehman said it had substantially hedged its current stake through a derivative contract with Olivetti. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
